SELECT CUSTOMER_ID customerId, CUSTOMER_NAME customerName, CUSTOMER_TYPE customerType, CONCAT(IFNULL( IS_ISSUER,'') , ',' ,IFNULL(IS_FINANCIER ,'') , ',' ,IFNULL( IS_ASSTE_MANAGER,'') , ',' , IFNULL( IS_TRUSTER,'') , ',' , IFNULL( IS_GUARANTEE,'') , ',' , IFNULL(IS_PLEDGOR ,'') , ',' , IFNULL( IS_SALER,'') , ',' , IFNULL( IS_DEPOSIT_BANK,'') , ',' , IFNULL(IS_INVEST_ADVISER ,'')) customerCharater FROM MST_CUSTOMER_INFO
CUSTOMER_NAME like concat(concat('%', #{customerName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%')
OR CUSTOMER_TYPE = #{CUSTOMER_TYPE_01}
OR CUSTOMER_TYPE = #{CUSTOMER_TYPE_02}
OR IS_ISSUER = 'Y'
OR IS_FINANCIER = 'Y'
OR IS_ASSTE_MANAGER = 'Y'
OR IS_TRUSTER = 'Y'
OR IS_GUARANTEE = 'Y'
OR IS_SALER = 'Y'
OR IS_DEPOSIT_BANK = 'Y'
OR IS_INVEST_ADVISER = 'Y'
OR IS_PLEDGOR = 'Y'
